mapper.sql: select wr.id, wr.user_id, wr.theme_title, wr.theme_snapshot, wr.location_name, wr.route_points, wr.missions_completed, wr.cover_image, wr.note_text, wr.is_public, wr.created_at, u.nickname as author_nickname, u.avatar_url as author_avatar, ifnull(wr.like_count, 0) as like_count, ifnull(wr.favorite_count, 0) as favorite_count, ifnull(wr.view_count, 0) as view_count, case when #{currentUserId} is not null and exists ( select 1 from walk_record_likes wrl where wrl.walk_id = wr.id and wrl.user_id = #{currentUserId} ) then 1 else 0 end as liked, case when #{currentUserId} is not null and exists ( select 1 from walk_record_favorites wrf where wrf.walk_id = wr.id and wrf.user_id = #{currentUserId} ) then 1 else 0 end as favorited, group_concat(distinct wrt.tag_name order by wrt.tag_name separator '||') as tags from walk_records wr left join users u on u.id = wr.user_id left join walk_record_tags wrt on wrt.walk_id = wr.id

group by wr.id, wr.user_id, wr.theme_title, wr.theme_snapshot, wr.location_name, wr.route_points, wr.missions_completed, wr.cover_image, wr.note_text, wr.is_public, wr.created_at, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, wr.like_count, wr.favorite_count, wr.view_count
mapper.select:
where wr.is_public = 1 and wr.status = 'active' and ( wr.theme_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(wr.location_name, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(wr.note_text, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(u.nickname, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or exists ( select 1 from walk_record_tags wrt2 where wrt2.walk_id = wr.id and wrt2.tag_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )
order by wr.created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

where wr.id = #{walkId} and wr.is_public = 1 and wr.status = 'active'
limit 1

where wr.is_public = 1 and wr.status = 'active'
order by wr.created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

where wr.is_public = 1 and wr.status = 'active'
order by ( ifnull(wr.like_count, 0) * 3 + ifnull(wr.favorite_count, 0) * 4 + ifnull(wr.view_count, 0) * 0.2 + case when ifnull(wr.cover_image, '') <> '' then 5 else 0 end + case when ifnull(wr.route_points, '') <> '' and wr.route_points <> '[]' then 3 else 0 end ) desc, wr.created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

where wr.is_public = 1 and wr.status = 'active'
order by ( ifnull(wr.like_count, 0) * 3 + ifnull(wr.favorite_count, 0) * 4 + ifnull(wr.view_count, 0) * 0.2 + case when ifnull(wr.cover_image, '') <> '' then 5 else 0 end + case when ifnull(wr.route_points, '') <> '' and wr.route_points <> '[]' then 3 else 0 end + case when timestampdiff(hour, wr.created_at, now()) <= 24 then 8 when timestampdiff(hour, wr.created_at, now()) <= 72 then 4 else 0 end ) desc, wr.created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
